# Let's inspect both protein and gene lengths via Ensembl API
ensembl_url = "https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/symbol/homo_sapiens/{symbol}?expand=1"
headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}

    start = res.get("start")
    end = res.get("end")
    span = end - start + 1 if start and end else None
    print(f"{sym} Ensembl Gene: {res.get('id')}, chr{res.get('seq_region_name')}:{start}-{end}, span: {span} bp")

        if tr.get("is_canonical"):
